TE Connectivity

TE Connectivity — Athens Highlights

Athens, Greece · 3–7 May 2025 · 450 guests

LocationAthens, Greece
Dates3–7 May 2025
Guests450 guests
Watch the film →

Five days in Athens in May 2025 for TE Connectivity’s technology team from the US, for 450 guests: a traditional Greek night, an Ancient Olympic Games experience at the Panathenaic Stadium, a gala dinner at the Zappeion and an evening at Dionysos Zonar’s.

The programme was documented on a Sony full-frame body across every venue, with on-the-ground iPhone frames from the Panathenaic Stadium.
